title: National Home for Disabled Volunteer Soldiers, Central Branch, Duplex, 4100 West Third Street, Dayton, Montgomery County, OH
notes: Significance: Built in 1895, the vernacular-style Duplex is the second oldest residence remaining on the campus of the Soldiers' National Home.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 03001412
